title: Farm To Storage
description: A powerful item transportation mod that beams items wirelessly across any distance. Features a channel system, persistent storage, and a 10x speed boost for efficient farm automation.
body:
## Key Features
* **Wireless Transport:** Unlimited distance between Senders and Receivers on the same channel.
* **Extreme Speed:** Transfer items 10 times per second (2-tick cooldown).
* **Network Dashboard:** Use `/itemnetwork` to manage all active nodes.
* **Smart Filtering:** Built-in filter slot and Glowstone speed support.
* **Data Safety:** Network states are saved automatically with the world.

## Instructions
1. Craft a **Sender** and a **Receiver**.
2. Set the channel by right-clicking with a **Stick**.
3. Sneak + right-click with a **Stick** to reset to channel 
4. Use `/itemnetwork` for a full overview.
